messages:
Taylor R: quick one — we need a final call on fetch behavior in the JS/TS SDK. Customers keep shipping undici into edge builds.
Ivy N: My vote: do NOT include undici as a builtin dep. Prefer globalThis.fetch, dynamic import undici only in Node server runtimes.
Oscar V: +1. Practically that means a tiny resolver: check globalThis.fetch, try require('undici') for CJS, then await import('undici') as fallback. Throw a clear error if none found.
Taylor R: can we also make the error prescriptive? e.g. "Install undici for Node <18: npm i undici && add polyfill at entrypoint" plus a link to docs.
Ivy N: yes — exact copy-paste snippets are essential. For CJS entrypoint: `(async ()=>{ globalThis.fetch = (await import('undici')).fetch; })();` For ESM: `globalThis.fetch = (await import('undici')).fetch;`
Oscar V: TS consumers: most forget to enable the DOM lib so they see type errors. We should export `type FetchLike = typeof fetch;` and show tsconfig: `{"lib": ["ES2020","DOM"]}` or `/// <reference lib="dom" />`.
Ken L: bundlers caveat: some bundlers will inline dynamic imports. Add examples for Next.js Edge: ensure undici is marked external/noExternal as appropriate. Also show Bun and Deno notes.
Docs Bot: drafted docs: /sdk/fetch with matrix (Node 16, Node 18+, Bun, Deno, Vercel/Cloudflare). Includes polyfill snippets, TS tips, troubleshooting FAQ.
Taylor R: runtime-detection code should be minimal and well-tested. Also add a lightweight examples folder: examples/node-legacy, examples/next-edge, examples/deno.
Ivy N: tests: add CI jobs that build the Next.js edge example and assert undici is not bundled. Add runtime tests for Node16 with polyfill and Node18 without.
Oscar V: performance note: undici still helps for very high QPS. We should recommend it for server apps with heavy throughput but keep it opt-in.
Taylor R: decision captured: default behavior = 1) prefer globalThis.fetch; 2) try require('undici') for CJS; 3) await import('undici') for ESM fallback; 4) if all fail throw clear error with remediation. No undici in runtime deps.
Ken L: I'll add onboarding blurb for support with the exact error wording and a checklist to ask customers about runtime (Node version, bundler, edge).
Ivy N: I'll implement the resolver + tests. Oscar -> docs review. Taylor -> open PR to gate CI.
